stem_book: If x ≠ nπ/2 and (cos x)^(sin²x − 3sin x + 2) = 1, then find the general solutions of x.
correct_answer: No solution (no x satisfies the equation)
work: x ≠ nπ/2 ⇒ 0 < |cos x| < 1, so the power is 1 only if sin²x − 3sin x + 2 = (sin x − 1)(sin x − 2) = 0 ⇒ sin x = 1 ⇒ x = 2nπ + π/2, excluded ⇒ no solution
